messages:

Date: 2026-05-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Prepay drawdown / ledger tagging requirements

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement here at Acme AI is working through the accounting requirements for our annual prepay commitment and we need to confirm two things before we finalize the PO:

1) Drawdown acceptance: who at Redwood signs off on each withdrawal (invoice) and what the acceptance window looks like (examples: 3 business days for simple usage reconciliations vs. 10 days for disputed items).
2) Ledger tagging: we require a CSV mapping with the following columns: invoice_id, drawdown_date, ledger_code, country_vat_rate, supporting_vat_proof_link. Can Redwood populate this automatically or will we get a weekly export?

We expect EU VAT evidence for our invoices (reverse charge in some countries). Can you confirm the format and a sample file?

Appreciate a short mutual action plan so our AP team can schedule the payment.

Thanks,
Elena Martinez
Procurement
Acme AI

Attachment: procurement-acme-invoice-template.pdf (stub)

From: jonas.weber@redwood.com

Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: 2026-05-30T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Prepay drawdown / ledger tagging requirements

Elena —

Thanks for the clear list. High level answer first, then an action plan: 

High level
- Drawdown acceptance: Redwood will issue a drawdown invoice at the time of withdrawal and we offer a standard 5-business-day acceptance window for reconciliations. After 5 business days the charge is considered accepted unless a dispute ticket is opened.
- Ledger tagging: We can provide a weekly CSV export with the exact columns you listed. We also support a one-time mapping upload so your ledger codes map to our invoice line items automatically.

Action items (proposed)
1) I will share a sample CSV and our VAT evidence template (Laura will confirm required fields). — by EOD today.
2) Acme to confirm preferred cadence: weekly export or API push. — Elena to respond by 2026-06-02.
3) Once cadence confirmed, Laura will enable the ledger mapping and provide the signed MOP (method of processing) for your AP team.

Attaching: preliminary drawdown-ledger-mapping.csv (stub) and a short checklist.

If that works Ill loop in Michael for final sign-off on the acceptance SLA.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: drawdown-ledger-mapping.csv (stub), ledger-acceptance-checklist.txt (stub)

From: laura.bennett@redwood.com
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com, Elena Martinez <elena@acmeai.com>
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: 2026-05-31T08:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Prepay drawdown / ledger tagging requirements — VAT evidence and MOP

Hi all,

Looping in finance ops detail here so Acme has what they need. Summary of what Redwood will provide and the format: 

1) Weekly export file (every Monday UTC) with columns: invoice_id, invoice_date, drawdown_amount_gbp, drawdown_date, ledger_code, country_vat_rate, vat_amount, vat_proof_id, supporting_vat_proof_link. We will populate country_vat_rate using the billing country on the customer account.

2) VAT evidence: we require either (A) the customers VAT registration number plus a signed reverse-charge declaration, or (B) a local VAT exemption certificate where applicable. We will attach a reference id (vat_proof_id) in the CSV and include a secure Drive link to the scanned document.

3) Acceptance SLA: finance will mark the invoice Accepted in our billing system after 5 business days provided no dispute ticket is open. For exceptions (large disputes >5k GBP) we will escalate and pause automatic acceptance until resolved.

4) Ledger mapping: please populate your ledger_code column using the template Im attaching. We can also consume a mapping file if you send back an export that maps your codes to our internal product_code (product_code is optional but recommended for automated reconciliation).

Attached for your review:
- acme_vat_evidence_template.xlsx (VAT evidence fields and sample entries)
- drawdown-ledger-mapping.csv (sample rows)
- signed-mop-2026.pdf (standard MOP; sign and return)

If Acme needs the weekly export pushed to an SFTP or a secure API endpoint we can do that — let us know the preferred endpoint and credentials (we prefer SFTP key-based for EU customers).

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Head of Finance Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments: acme_vat_evidence_template.xlsx (stub), drawdown-ledger-mapping.csv (stub), signed-mop-2026.pdf (stub)

- We will provide a one-time mapping file mapping our ledger codes to Redwood product_code. Can you confirm youll ingest that and start delivering weekly exports the Monday after you receive it?
- For VAT evidence we will provide VAT numbers and reverse-charge declarations for the UK, DE, FR and NL within 3 business days. Should those be uploaded to the Drive link in your CSV or emailed to finance@redwood.com?
- Final sign-off: who approves the Acceptance SLA and the MOP on Redwoods side so Procurement can close the PO? We need a named approver for our internal control.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — once we confirm the named approver we can issue the PO and trigger the prepay.

Best,
Elena
